mentions.name: Slay the Spire AI Agent
mentions.description: This AI agent plays the roguelike deckbuilder Slay the Spire, combining two search approaches: sparse graph search for deck building and MCTS for combat. It consistently reaches Ascension 20 Act 3 and occasionally defeats the A20 Heart.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an AI agent that plays Slay the Spire. It currently reaches A20 Act 3 consistently and occasionally defeats the A20 Heart. It use two search: spare graph search for deck building, and MCTS for combat.
